method: Read every original source line in bounded numbered chunks with leading display indentation trimmed; no source edits.
reviewedDecisions: Flow evaluates the source before targets; contextual integer/container arguments and printer fast path retain semantic target identity.
Declared instance/global functions precede container intrinsic-by-name dispatch; generic resolved calls and dynamic trait conversion/dispatch retain their direct semantic facts.
Runtime function kind switch delegates platform IO/socket/process/async operations with supported-target and final-target restrictions.
Task await/cancel consumes the exact local task or field projection; Arena/collection mutation requires writable addressable storage.
Container mutations store updated storage to named owner or validated struct-field place and remove moved owned literal sources.
Function-returned temporary ownership is tracked independently of the initial source place for append/updated move consumers.
Text/SourceText byte indexes check UIntSize bounds before load, mapped flush checks runtime status, and unknown functions throw.
limitations: Physical review alone does not certify full dispatch/helper equivalence, platform runtime behavior or source7 closure.
Arity/type/ownership preconditions of many dispatch branches are owned by semantic analysis and delegated emitter helpers.
No new independently reproduced defect or unrelated source refactor was introduced.
